children: President Trump concluded nearly two hours of remarks by promising to return for the second night of the GOP convention but to keep his subsequent speech short.

"I don't have to say the same stuff twice. I gave you a lot of material. I don't have to do it twice," he quipped. His follow up address Thursday night, the president explained, would be "to say good night to you."
This item is part of a Wall Street Journal live coverage event. The full stream can be found by searching P/WSJL (WSJ Live Coverage).

title: Trump Ends Remarks, Promises to Return Thursday to Say 'Goodnight' — WSJ
